text: EXTRAORDINARYThe Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
Notification of Taxes, Rates, Royalties, Service Fee and other Fees - 2026

I, the Commissioner of Municipal Council of Kalmunai, hereby inform the public that, by virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 286 (a) of Chapter 252 of the Municipal Councils Ordinance, as per the By-laws enacted under the Local Authorities (Standard By-laws) Act, No. 6 of 1952 and published in Extra Ordinary Gazette No. 541/17 of 20/01/1989, as per the Standard By-laws of the Local Authorities published in the Local Government Gazette No. 1093 of 13.08.1993 by an order of the Eastern Province Governor and based on the Management Committee Resolutions, all the following fees will be implemented from 01.01.2026 and any other fees not mentioned here will be levied according to the decisions of the Municipal Council, Kalmunai.
I hereby inform the public that I revoke and cancel the Extraordinary Gazette Notification No. 2381/26 dated 24/04/2024.
A. T. M. Rafee, Commissioner.Municipal Council,Kalmunai,26th December, 2025.

Instructions and conditions (Schedule I, Schedule II and Schedule III)

• It is here by requested to obtain the Trade License before 31st of march, 2026 and the business activities which func-tioning without Trade License will be considered illegal and legal action will be taken against them.
• The assessment tax of the residential and the commercial premises of the applicant should have been paid at the time of settlement of the above charge.
• The businesses that involved in food and human body related products should have taken recommendation from the M.O.H / P.H.I.
• If the businesses related with food, the Trade License and the Food Premises License should have been obtained before January 15.
• If a business involves in more than one business activity above mentioned, it should pay separate fee for each business activity.
• If there any fee not mentioned in the above schedule, such fees will be decided by the Municipal Council and it will be the finality.
• As per the existing legal provisions other approvals that need to be obtained from other departments other than the Municipal council should be provided when submitting application.

As per Section 238 of Chapter 252 of Municipal Councils Ordinance and its sub sections and as per the decision No. 04 dated 03.10.2025 of the council to imposition and recover of property tax on the movable and immovable prop-erties situated within the boundary of Municipal Council, Kalmunai, it is hereby informed that the property tax will be rlevied from 01.01.2026.
This tax will be paid as per the following procedure :-
1. The tax calculation shall be for the entire year.
2. The tax amount can be paid on a quarterly basis. Accordingly, the tax amount shall be settled on or before the following dates.
3. In the event of settling the entire amount of the tax assessed for the year 2026 before 31st of January, 2026, a discount of 10% of due tax will be given to the tax payer.
4. 5% of discount will be given to those who settle the entire amount of the first quarter year in the first month of the quarter year.
